'''Oilseed Bloom Plot''' is an [[AIC]] [[Facilities|facility]] in ''[[Arknights: Endfield]]''.

{{Item description|To use this plot, follow the steps of fine cultivation and harvest the ripened crops to get plenty of Oilseed Blooms.|A cultivation plot with various parameters adjusted for growing Oilseed Blooms.
